note: Each file in refusals/ must fail to load; the value is a fragment of the error. Go (internal/marking) and the TypeScript port read this same list.

refusals.ambiguous-token: token "A" is in groups tags and more at the same level
refusals.token-outside-group-levels: allowed at a level its group is not
refusals.vocabulary: only a built-in preset reads a vocabulary file
refusals.token-separator: token "A/B" is not a banner word
refusals.prefix-with-tokens: a prefix group takes no tokens
refusals.ambiguous-three: token "A" is in groups one and three at the same level
refusals.prefix-collision: groups one and two accept the same words ("P-", "P-")
refusals.prefix-nested: groups one and two accept the same words ("P-", "P-X")
refusals.suffix-literal-collision: groups one and two accept the same words ("A-", "A-B")
refusals.prefix-literal-collision: groups one and two accept the same words ("P-", "P-Q")
refusals.token-every-level-in-narrow-group: token "A" is allowed at a level its group is not
refusals.retired-in-deployment: retired markings belong to the built-in presets
refusals.level-trailing-space: level name "LOW " is not a banner word
refusals.token-trailing-space: token "A " is not a banner word
refusals.group-overlap-disjoint-levels: tokens "X" and "X-A" of group tags can be written the same way
refusals.version-beyond-range: number 9007199254740993 is not a whole number from 0 to 999999
refusals.version-fraction: number 1.0 is not a whole number from 0 to 999999
refusals.level-exponent: number 1e0 is not a whole number from 0 to 999999
refusals.position-negative: number -1 is not a whole number from 0 to 999999
